extracted_clauses.text: This policy covers expenses and entitlements of employees who travel on company’s business, or deputed to attend seminars / conferences / workshops /training programs. It highlights entitlements during travel including Accommodation, Food, and Local conveyance.
This policy shall be applicable to all employees of NAGA LIMITED.

Employees are allowed to stay in their relative/ friends home/ room, in the touring destination. IF staying with relatives/friends, they can claim 25% of their eligible amount and are NOT required to produce bills.
For Twin sharing, the claim can be made to the maximum of 125% of the eligible amount of the Senior level employee.

entities.claimBasis: eligible amount of the Senior level employee

extracted_clauses.text: All tours MUST be made in accordance with the tour programme duly sanctioned by the Reporting Manager.
Travel on Company account will be on the most economical basis, consistent with the Company’s interest, dignity and work requirement.
Employees SHALL claim the Travel entitlements as per the eligibilities fixed based on their job levels i.e. Job band and grade as per the Company Policy.
All travels SHALL be supported by original bills.
Travelling advance MUST be settled within 2 days after the tour programme.
Travelling advance CANNOT be entertained IF there is any balance in the employee's account.
Incase of not getting bills in remote areas, the employee can claim the eligible amount by self attestation.
The claims approved by reporting manager SHALL be validated by HR & Accounts.
Boarding & Lodging CANNOT be claimed as a combined limit.
For Boarding/Lodging, the eligible amount or bill amount, whichever is less, will apply.

entities.boardingLodgingRule: eligible amount or bill amount, whichever is less

extracted_clauses.text: Employees other than sales personnel shall be eligible for Food Reimbursement during out of office work (at business associates etc.) if spending more than 6 hours.
No official Travel by Personal Car MUST exceed 200 kms on any day by Self Drive for Safety Reasons.
Beyond 200 Kms of personal car travel MAY be encouraged only for Group Travel – 3 or more people.
No Driver Charges SHALL be paid for personal car travel.
No official Travel by Personal Bike MUST exceed 50 kms on any day.
This policy came into effect from 01st April 2014.
